```{r, results='asis'}
report_path <- Sys.getenv("MEDICAL_EVALUATION_REPORT_JSON", unset = "")
if (!nzchar(report_path) || !file.exists(report_path)) {
  stop("MEDICAL_EVALUATION_REPORT_JSON must name the explicit current-run model.")
}
if (!requireNamespace("jsonlite", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("Rendering requires the already prepared jsonlite package.")
}
report <- jsonlite::fromJSON(report_path, simplifyVector = FALSE)
if (!identical(report$schema_version, "medical_evaluation_report_model_v1") ||
    !identical(report$medical_performance_validated, FALSE) ||
    !identical(report$review_coverage_available, FALSE) ||
    !identical(report$qualification$feature_enabled_by_default, FALSE) ||
    !identical(report$qualification$medical_performance, "pending") ||
    !is.null(report$official_assessment)) {
  stop("Unsupported or authority-changing evaluation report model.")
}
cat(report$rendered_markdown)
```
